metadata.title: Urban Stoop Portrait with Hand-Lettered Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned monochrome photograph of a man in a leather jacket sitting on weathered metal stairs, featuring vibrant yellow hand-painted lettering that contrasts with the gritty, industrial background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset horizontally against the diagonal lines of the stairs.
Bright yellow typography pops against the dark, textured mid-tones of the background.
Rough, tactile grain of the photo complements the jagged, brush-stroke quality of the text.
coreInvariants: Sepia-tinted monochrome color space for the image.
Weathered metal or stone stair backdrop with repeating horizontal patterns.
Subject wearing dark, reflective textures like leather.
Hand-drawn, non-uniform letterforms in a single high-contrast accent color.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated centrally, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically, scaled to show full torso and legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands provide the primary focal points, framed by the dark leather jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright yellow text in the top left, follows the diagonal lines of the stairs down to the subject, and settles on the secondary text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is dominated by the repeating texture of the stairs, providing breathing room for the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep sepia and charcoal tones (background and subject).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white highlights on the subject's face and the stair edges.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the image with high value contrast; high saturation and high value in the typography.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, black, white, and one primary accent color

letterConstructionRules: Irregular stroke widths mimicking a flat brush
Rounded terminals with visible paint-like texture
All-caps construction with varying character heights
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'L' has a short, thick base
The letter 'O' is slightly squashed and tilted
The letter 'A' has a high crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent hand-lettered style used for both primary and secondary text to maintain a cohesive 'signed' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the thick, tactile quality of the original lettering.
Matches the urban, casual aesthetic of the composition.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, sepia-toned monochrome photograph of a man in a black leather jacket sitting on industrial metal stairs. The lighting should be harsh, creating high contrast on the face. The background should show repeating patterns of the stair treads.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted, thick-stroke yellow lettering in the top-left and bottom-left corners. The text should look like it was applied with a physical brush, featuring slightly irregular edges and a vibrant, opaque yellow color.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly sepia/monochrome except for the yellow text?
Does the text have a tactile, hand-drawn quality?
Is the grain/halftone texture visible across the entire image?
Is the subject's pose relaxed and seated on stairs?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the brush strokes in the lettering
Subject's clothing (e.g., denim instead of leather)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any trademarked logos or technical audio icons
Exact wording of the original titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is the only source of color.
Check that the stair texture doesn't overwhelm the subject.
Verify the 'halftone' print effect is consistent.
Confirm the lettering looks painted, not typed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochrome urban portrait with vibrant, hand-painted yellow display type to create a gritty, 1980s-inspired editorial aesthetic.
